clues.narrowing: rules out all places outside western South Africa

source.quote: Villiersdorp is a small town located in the Western Cape province of South Africa in the Overberg region, located near the Theewaterskloof Dam.

clues.text: Most farms round here grow wheat and canola crops. Since a huge dam was built, this valley changed, and its small local climate now suits fruit trees and grape vines best.
clues.narrowing: rules out the wheat valleys round it that have no dam-changed climate

source.quote: Unlike most of the geographical region which specialises in wheat and canola farming, the Villiersdorp Valley is now agriculturally and in micro-climate more similar to the Elgin Valley and Grabouw since the building of the Theewaterskloof Dam, and thus also specialises in deciduous fruit farming and viticulture.

source.quote: Alexandria is a small farming town in the Eastern Cape of South Africa and is situated 100 km north-east of Gqeberha on the R72 road to Bushman's River Mouth, Kenton-on-Sea and Port Alfred.
